name: MariaDB - Crash Recovery Attempts by Host

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/mariadb db_system=mariadb db_cluster=* "Crash recovery"
| json "log" nodrop | if (_raw matches "{*", log, _raw) as mesg
| where mesg matches "*Crash recovery*"
| if (isEmpty(pod),_sourceHost,pod) as host
| count as recovery_attempts by host, db_cluster 
| Sort by recovery_attempts
